resources.string: Set up once. Then jump straight into VR.

1. Copy your original Xbox USA (NTSC-U) ISO, XISO, ZIP or 7z to the Download folder on your Quest. \n2. Select the file below. Xbox ISO images inside archives are unpacked automatically. \n3. Wait for the import to finish, then start the game.

Requires the complete NFS Underground 1 Xbox USA disc: default.xbe and CARS, FRONTEND, GLOBAL, LANGUAGES, MEMCARD, MOVIES, SOUND and TRACKS. PC, European and Underground 2 editions are unsupported. Import needs temporary space for a copy of your source, any contained ISO, and about 1.9 GB of installed files. Allow about 18 GB extra for a 7z containing a full disc image, or 5 GB for an archive of extracted files. Existing saved games are kept.
Open “NFSU1 · Game data” to return here later. The normal game entry starts directly in VR.
The existing data will only be replaced after the new archive has been fully verified. Your saved games and settings will be kept.
Could not open the Android file picker. Restart your Quest, then open “NFSU1 · Game data” again.
Your existing game data and saved games will be kept.
